func TestLocalSourceRefresh(t *testing.T) {
 dir := t.TempDir()
 layout, err := oci.New(path.Join(dir, \"flags\"))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 layout.AutoSaveIndex = true
 ctx := context.Background()
 publish := func(key string) {
  t.Helper()
  payload := fmt.Sprintf("'`{"flags":[{"key":%q,"name":%q,"enabled":true,"type":"VARIANT_FLAG_TYPE"}]}`, key, key)
  layer := v1.Descriptor{MediaType: fliptoci.MediaTypeFliptNamespace, Digest: digest.FromString(payload), Size: int64(len(payload)), Annotations: map[string]string{fliptoci.AnnotationFliptNamespace: "team"}}
  require.NoError(t, layout.Push(ctx, layer, bytes.NewReader([]byte(payload))))
  desc, err := oras.PackManifest(ctx, layout, oras.PackManifestVersion1_1_RC4, fliptoci.MediaTypeFliptFeatures, oras.PackManifestOptions{Layers: []v1.Descriptor{layer}})
  require.NoError(t, err)
  require.NoError(t, layout.Tag(ctx, desc, "latest"))
 }
 publish("first")
 store, err := fliptoci.NewStore(&config.OCI{BundleDirectory: dir, Repository: "flipt://local/flags:latest"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 source, err := NewSource(zaptest.NewLogger(t), store, WithPollInterval(10*time.Millisecond))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 first, err := source.Get(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = first.GetFlag(ctx, "team", "first")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 same, err := source.Get(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Same(t, first, same)
 publish("second")
 second, err := source.Get(ctx)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NotSame(t, first, second)
 flag, err := second.GetFlag(ctx, "team", "second")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Equal(t, "second", flag.Key)
 _ = flipt.Flag{}
}
EOF

item.text:
Added the OCI snapshot source in [source.go](/app/internal/storage/fs/oci/source.go). It supports local layouts and remote registries, reopens local layouts on each fetch, reuses snapshots when the digest is unchanged, and polls for changes with a 30-second default. I also updated `SnapshotSource.Get` and existing sources to accept a context, and added OCI layer namespace and gzip handling.

The local refresh and subscription tests pass, along with `go test ./internal/oci ./internal/storage/fs/...`, `go test ./internal/cmd`, and `git diff --check`.
